why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. Item 1 holds: verifier Check 3 lists every exported function without a README heading and fails when "missing names any function, slugify included", so a README with only a padLeft section can't pass. Item 2 breaks. Check 1 calls padLeft('1', 4, 'ab') and passes only if "the second line printed is TypeError, because fill must be a single character", and it fails on "NO THROW". Expect line 1 never says fill must be one character, so this is exactly the forbidden "fill must be one character" check. Check 3's regex also adds a layout rule the line doesn't state. It wants a heading of the form '^#+ name(', so a section titled "## slugify" with no parenthesis would fail. One forbidden condition is enough to fail the criterion.
